title: Superpowers plugin
summary: Skills for planning, debugging, code review, worktrees and proving work before calling it done.
benefit: Claude plans, debugs and reviews in tested steps and proves work before calling it done.
solves: Work called done without proof, and bugs fixed by guessing.
use_cases: A bug or failing test: Claude debugs in fixed steps before it proposes a fix.
Before calling work done, Claude runs the checks and shows the evidence.
Bigger work: written plans, isolated git worktrees and a code review step.
Its forced brainstorming and test-first loops are skipped unless you ask or use "-p".
details: Once installed, Claude gets skills for planning, debugging, code review, worktrees and proving work before calling it done, and a short rule tells it to keep the verification gate and skip the forced brainstorming and TDD loops unless you ask for them. It is for you if you want that discipline without the full loops every time. It is a plugin from the official marketplace plus one rule file that loads every session; the plugin loads skills and may add its own hooks.
risk: Installed from the official marketplace; loads skills and may add hooks. Nothing is shipped here.
